title: Guide us to the straight path
arabic: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
transliteration: Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim. Siratal-ladhina an'amta 'alayhim, ghayril-maghdubi 'alayhim wa lad-dallin.
english_translation: Guide us to the straight path — the path of those You have favoured, not of those who earned anger, nor of those who went astray.
roman_urdu_translation: Hamein seedhe raste par chala. Un logon ke raste par jin par tu ne inaam kiya, un ke nahin jin par ghazab hua aur na un ke jo bhatak gaye.
explanation: A request for guidance that is recited in every rak'ah of the prayer: to be shown the right way and to be kept on it.
arabic_parts: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Accept this from us, and accept our repentance
arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas-sami'ul-'alim. Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan lak, wa arina manasikana wa tub 'alayna innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim.
english_translation: Our Lord, accept this from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. Our Lord, make us submissive to You, and make from our descendants a community submissive to You. Show us our rites of worship and accept our repentance; You are the Ever-Accepting of repentance, the Most Merciful.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hum se qabool farma, beshak tu sunne wala jaanne wala hai. Ae hamare Rab! Hamein apna farmanbardar bana aur hamari aulaad mein se bhi ek farmanbardar ummat bana. Hamein hamare ibadat ke tareeqe dikha aur hamari tauba qabool farma, beshak tu bohat tauba qabool karne wala, meherbaan hai.
explanation: Asks Allah to accept one's deeds, to keep one's family submitted to Him, and to accept repentance.
context: Made by Prophets Ibrahim and Isma'il (peace be upon them) while raising the foundations of the Ka'bah.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Good in this world and in the next
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
english_translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the next world, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hamein dunya mein bhalai de aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalai de, aur hamein aag ke azaab se bacha.
explanation: A comprehensive request for what is good in both lives and for protection from the Fire.
context: Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that this was the supplication the Prophet ﷺ made most often.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Pour patience upon us and make our feet firm
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
english_translation: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hum par sabr undel de, hamare qadam jama de aur kafir qaum ke muqable mein hamari madad farma.
explanation: Asks for patience, firmness and help when facing a great trial.
context: The supplication of the believers with Talut (Saul) when they faced Jalut (Goliath) and his army.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Do not burden us beyond what we can bear
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na. Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
english_translation: Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place on us a burden like the one You placed on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Agar hum bhool jayen ya ghalti karein to hamein na pakad. Ae hamare Rab! Hum par woh bojh na daal jo tu ne hum se pehle logon par dala. Ae hamare Rab! Hum se woh na uthwa jis ki hamein taqat nahin. Hamein maaf kar de, hamein bakhsh de aur hum par raham farma. Tu hi hamara maula hai, to kafir qaum ke muqable mein hamari madad farma.
explanation: The closing supplication of Surat al-Baqarah. It asks for pardon for mistakes, relief from burdens too heavy to carry, and mercy.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-wahhab.
english_translation: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. You are the Ever-Giving.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hamein hidayat dene ke baad hamare dilon ko tedha na kar, aur apni taraf se hamein rehmat ata farma. Beshak tu hi bohat ata karne wala hai.
explanation: Asks Allah to keep the heart firm on guidance once it has been given.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: We have believed, so forgive us and protect us from the Fire
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunubana wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
english_translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hum iman laye, pas hamare gunah maaf farma aur hamein aag ke azaab se bacha.
explanation: A short request for forgiveness and safety from the Fire, offered on the basis of one's faith.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Grant me good offspring from Yourself
arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka sami'ud-du'a'.
english_translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. You are the Hearer of supplication.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mujhe apni taraf se nek aulaad ata farma. Beshak tu dua sunne wala hai.
explanation: A request for righteous children.
context: The supplication of Prophet Zakariyya (peace be upon him).
arabic_parts: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Forgive our sins and our excesses, and make our feet firm
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lana dhunubana wa israfana fi amrina wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
english_translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hamare gunah aur apne kaam mein hamari ziyadatiyan maaf farma, hamare qadam jama de aur kafir qaum par hamari madad farma.
explanation: Pairs a request for forgiveness with a request for firmness. The people it describes first admitted their own shortcomings, then asked for steadfastness.
context: The words of the devoted followers of earlier prophets, as described in Surah Al 'Imran.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Allah is enough for us, and the best disposer of affairs
arabic: حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil.
english_translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.
roman_urdu_translation: Humein Allah kaafi hai aur woh behtareen kaam banane wala hai.
explanation: A declaration of reliance on Allah rather than a request. It is said when one feels overwhelmed or threatened.
context: Ibn 'Abbas (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that Ibrahim (peace be upon him) said it when he was thrown into the fire, and that Muhammad ﷺ said it when people told him that a gathering had assembled against them.
arabic_parts: حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: You did not create this in vain; protect us from the Fire
arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَٰطِلًا سُبْحَٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batila, subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar.
english_translation: Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You; protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Tu ne yeh sab bekaar paida nahin kiya. Tu paak hai, pas hamein aag ke azaab se bacha.
explanation: Said by those who reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth, and who then turn to Allah for protection.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَٰطِلًا سُبْحَٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Forgive us, and let us die among the righteous
arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِى لِلْإِيمَٰنِ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-imani an aminu birabbikum fa amanna. Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar. Rabbana wa atina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamah, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad.
english_translation: Our Lord, we heard a caller calling to faith: 'Believe in your Lord,' and we believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins, erase our bad deeds, and take our souls with the righteous. Our Lord, give us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break Your promise.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Humne ek pukarne wale ko suna jo iman ki taraf bulata tha ke apne Rab par iman lao, to hum iman le aaye. Ae hamare Rab! Hamare gunah bakhsh de, hamari buraiyan mita de aur hamein nek logon ke saath maut de. Ae hamare Rab! Jo tu ne apne rasoolon ke zariye hum se wada kiya woh hamein ata farma aur qayamat ke din hamein ruswa na kar. Beshak tu wada khilafi nahin karta.
explanation: Asks for forgiveness, for a good ending among the righteous, and for protection from disgrace on the Day of Resurrection.
arabic_parts: رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِى لِلْإِيمَٰنِ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: We have wronged ourselves
arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa il-lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
english_translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Humne apni jaanon par zulm kiya. Agar tu hamein maaf na kare aur hum par raham na farmaye to hum zaroor nuqsan uthane walon mein se ho jayenge.
explanation: An admission of fault together with a direct plea for forgiveness and mercy.
context: The words of Adam and Hawwa (peace be upon them) after they ate from the tree, as told in Surat al-A'raf.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Pour patience upon us and take us as Muslims
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa tawaffana muslimin.
english_translation: Our Lord, pour patience upon us and take our souls as Muslims.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hum par sabr undel de aur hamein is haal mein maut de ke hum musalman hon.
explanation: A request for patience under pressure and for a faithful ending.
context: Said by Pharaoh's magicians after they believed in Musa (peace be upon him) and were threatened.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: In Allah we place our trust
arabic: عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: 'Alallahi tawakkalna. Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lil-qawmiz-zalimin, wa najjina birahmatika minal-qawmil-kafirin.
english_translation: In Allah we place our trust. Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people, and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
roman_urdu_translation: Humne Allah hi par bharosa kiya. Ae hamare Rab! Hamein zalim logon ke liye aazmaish na bana, aur apni rehmat se hamein kafir qaum se najat de.
explanation: Combines reliance on Allah with a request for protection from oppression.
context: The reply of the believers among the people of Musa (peace be upon him) when he told them to rely on Allah.
arabic_parts: عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Take my soul as a Muslim and join me with the righteous
arabic: فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, anta waliyyi fid-dunya wal-akhirah, tawaffani musliman wa alhiqni bis-salihin.
english_translation: Creator of the heavens and the earth, You are my Protector in this world and the next. Take my soul as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae aasmanon aur zameen ke paida karne wale! Tu dunya aur aakhirat mein mera kaarsaz hai. Mujhe musalman hone ki halat mein maut de aur mujhe nek logon ke saath mila de.
explanation: Asks for a good ending and for the company of the righteous.
context: The supplication of Prophet Yusuf (peace be upon him) after Allah had granted him honour and reunited him with his family.
arabic_parts: فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Keep me and my children steadfast in prayer; forgive my parents
arabic: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
transliteration: Rabbij'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, rabbana wa taqabbal du'a'. Rabbanaghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
english_translation: My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and make my descendants do the same. Our Lord, accept my supplication. Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the reckoning takes place.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mujhe namaz qaim karne wala bana aur meri aulaad mein se bhi. Ae hamare Rab! Meri dua qabool farma. Ae hamare Rab! Mujhe, mere walidain ko aur sab momino ko hisab ke din bakhsh de.
explanation: A request for steadfastness in prayer across generations, and for forgiveness for oneself, one's parents and the believers.
context: The supplication of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him).
arabic_parts: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Have mercy on my parents as they raised me when I was small
arabic: رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.
english_translation: My Lord, have mercy on them, as they raised me when I was small.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! In dono par raham farma jaisa ke unhon ne bachpan mein meri parwarish ki.
explanation: The Quran's own wording for praying for one's parents with gratitude for how they raised us.
arabic_parts: رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Let my entering and my leaving be with truth
arabic: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbi adkhilni mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijni mukhraja sidqin waj'al li min ladunka sultanan nasira.
english_translation: My Lord, let my entering be an entering with truth, and my leaving a leaving with truth, and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mujhe sachai ke saath dakhil kar aur sachai ke saath nikal, aur mujhe apni taraf se madadgar quwwat ata farma.
explanation: Asks that one's beginnings and endings, arrivals and departures, be upright and supported by Allah.
context: Revealed to the Prophet ﷺ as a supplication in the period around his migration from Makkah.
arabic_parts: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Grant us mercy and prepare for us right guidance in our affair
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada.
english_translation: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and prepare for us right guidance in our affair.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hamein apni taraf se rehmat ata farma aur hamare kaam mein hamare liye hidayat ka saman faraham kar.
explanation: A request for mercy and for a way out that is rightly guided, made when no clear path was visible.
context: The supplication of the youths who took refuge in the cave (Ashab al-Kahf).
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Expand my chest and ease my task
arabic: رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli.
english_translation: My Lord, expand my chest for me, ease my task for me, and untie the knot from my tongue so that they may understand my speech.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mera seena khol de, mera kaam mere liye aasan kar de, aur meri zubaan ki girah khol de taake woh meri baat samajh sakein.
explanation: Asks for confidence, ease, and clear speech before a difficult responsibility.
context: The supplication of Musa (peace be upon him) when he was sent to Pharaoh.
arabic_parts: رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: My Lord, increase me in knowledge
arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma.
english_translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mere ilm mein izafa farma.
explanation: A short request that the Quran itself presents as a supplication for more knowledge.
arabic_parts: رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Harm has touched me, and You are the most merciful of those who show mercy
arabic: أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
transliteration: Anni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin.
english_translation: Indeed, hardship has touched me, and You are the most merciful of those who show mercy.
roman_urdu_translation: Mujhe takleef pahunchi hai aur tu sab rahm karne walon se badh kar rahm karne wala hai.
explanation: A humble description of one's suffering placed before Allah, without a demand attached.
context: The supplication of Prophet Ayyub (Job), peace be upon him.
arabic_parts: أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: There is no god but You; glory be to You; I was among the wrongdoers
arabic: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
english_translation: There is no god but You. Glory be to You; indeed I have been among the wrongdoers.
roman_urdu_translation: Tere siwa koi mabood nahin, tu paak hai, beshak main hi zalimon mein se tha.
explanation: Affirms Allah's oneness and holiness and admits one's own fault, in the midst of deep distress.
context: The supplication of Prophet Yunus (Jonah) in the darkness inside the whale. Al-Tirmidhi also narrates the Prophet ﷺ's encouragement to make this supplication; that narration's grading is under review in this collection.
arabic_parts: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors
arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa anta khayrul-warithin.
english_translation: My Lord, do not leave me alone (without an heir), and You are the best of inheritors.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mujhe akela (be aulaad) na chhod, aur tu sab se behtar waris hai.
explanation: Asks for a child and an heir while leaving the outcome entirely with Allah.
context: The supplication of Prophet Zakariyya (peace be upon him), who longed for offspring.
arabic_parts: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Let me land at a blessed landing place
arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khayrul-munzilin.
english_translation: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best of those who bring to land.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mujhe barkat wali jagah utar, aur tu sab se behtar utarne wala hai.
explanation: Asks for a blessed place to settle and for blessing in a new beginning.
context: Allah instructed Nuh (peace be upon him) to say this when the ark was ready.
arabic_parts: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: I seek refuge in You from the whisperings of the devils
arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
transliteration: Rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazatish-shayatin, wa a'udhu bika rabbi an yahduruni.
english_translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Main shaitanon ke uksane se teri panah mangta hoon, aur ae mere Rab! Is se bhi teri panah mangta hoon ke woh mere paas aayein.
explanation: Seeks refuge from the whispers and presence of the devils.
context: Allah taught this supplication to the Prophet ﷺ in Surat al-Mu'minun.
arabic_parts: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: My Lord, forgive and have mercy
arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbighfir warham wa anta khayrur-rahimin.
english_translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of those who show mercy.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Maaf farma aur raham farma, aur tu sab se behtar raham karne wala hai.
explanation: A brief, complete request for forgiveness and mercy that can be said at any moment.
arabic_parts: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Turn away from us the punishment of Hell
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
transliteration: Rabbanas-rif 'anna 'adhaba jahannam, inna 'adhabaha kana gharama.
english_translation: Our Lord, turn away from us the punishment of Hell; its punishment is a lasting torment.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hum se jahannam ka azaab phair de, beshak uska azaab chimat jane wali museebat hai.
explanation: Asks Allah to keep the person away from Hellfire.
context: A description of the 'servants of the Most Merciful' in Surat al-Furqan.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Grant us comfort in our spouses and children
arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama.
english_translation: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and our children the joy of our eyes, and make us an example for the righteous.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hamein hamari biwiyon aur aulaad se ankhon ki thandak ata farma aur hamein parhezgaron ka imam bana.
explanation: A request for a family that brings contentment and for being a good example to others.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Inspire me to be grateful for Your favour
arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa adkhilni birahmatika fi 'ibadikas-salihin.
english_translation: My Lord, inspire me to be thankful for Your favour which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and to do righteous deeds that please You, and admit me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mujhe taufeeq de ke main teri us naimat ka shukr ada karoon jo tu ne mujh par aur mere walidain par ki, aur aisa nek amal karoon jis se tu razi ho, aur apni rehmat se mujhe apne nek bandon mein shamil farma.
explanation: Asks for the ability to be grateful, to do deeds that please Allah, and to be counted among the righteous.
context: The supplication of Prophet Sulayman (Solomon), peace be upon him.
arabic_parts: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى
transliteration: Rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li.
english_translation: My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Maine apni jaan par zulm kiya, pas mujhe maaf farma de.
explanation: One of the shortest Quranic requests for forgiveness: an admission followed immediately by the plea.
context: The words of Musa (peace be upon him) after he struck a man and the man died; the verse then says Allah forgave him.
arabic_parts: رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: I am in need of whatever good You send down to me
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
english_translation: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Jo bhi bhalai tu mujh par nazil farmaye main uska mohtaj hoon.
explanation: An open, humble statement of need that does not dictate to Allah what form the good should take.
context: Musa (peace be upon him) said this after reaching Madyan as a stranger, exhausted and with nothing.
arabic_parts: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Grant me a righteous child
arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi hab li minas-salihin.
english_translation: My Lord, grant me (offspring) from among the righteous.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mujhe nek aulaad ata farma.
explanation: A short request for righteous offspring.
context: The supplication of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him).
arabic_parts: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Inspire me to be grateful and make my children righteous
arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati, inni tubtu ilayka wa inni minal-muslimin.
english_translation: My Lord, inspire me to be thankful for Your favour which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and to do righteous deeds that please You, and make my offspring righteous for me. Indeed, I have turned to You in repentance, and indeed I am among the Muslims.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mujhe taufeeq de ke main teri us naimat ka shukr karoon jo tu ne mujh par aur mere walidain par ki, aur aisa nek amal karoon jis se tu razi ho, aur meri aulaad ko mere liye saleh bana de. Main ne teri taraf tauba ki aur main farmanbardaron mein se hoon.
explanation: Joins gratitude, parents, righteous deeds, children and repentance in a single supplication.
arabic_parts: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Do not place resentment in our hearts toward the believers
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lana wa li-ikhwaninal-ladhina sabaquna bil-imani wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lil-ladhina amanu, rabbana innaka ra'ufur-rahim.
english_translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers and sisters who preceded us in faith, and do not put in our hearts any resentment toward those who believe. Our Lord, You are Kind and Merciful.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hamein aur hamare un bhaiyon ko bakhsh de jo iman mein hum se aage nikal gaye, aur hamare dilon mein iman walon ke liye kina na rakh. Ae hamare Rab! Beshak tu bohat shafeeq, meherbaan hai.
explanation: Asks for forgiveness for oneself and others, and for a heart free of resentment.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Perfect our light for us and forgive us
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbana atmim lana nurana waghfir lana, innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
english_translation: Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us. Indeed, You have power over all things.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae hamare Rab! Hamare liye hamara noor mukammal kar de aur hamein bakhsh de, beshak tu har cheez par qadir hai.
explanation: The Quran describes believers saying this on the Day of Resurrection, as their light goes before them.
context: From Surat at-Tahrim, in a verse that follows a call to sincere repentance.
arabic_parts: رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Forgive me, my parents, and the believing men and women
arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ
transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa liwalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat.
english_translation: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my house as a believer, and the believing men and women.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae mere Rab! Mujhe, mere walidain ko, aur jo bhi momin ho kar mere ghar mein dakhil ho, aur tamam momin mardon aur momin aurton ko bakhsh de.
explanation: Includes parents, household and the whole believing community in one's request for forgiveness.
context: The supplication of Prophet Nuh (peace be upon him).
arabic_parts: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: With hardship comes ease
arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
transliteration: Fa inna ma'al-'usri yusra. Inna ma'al-'usri yusra.
english_translation: Indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
roman_urdu_translation: Beshak mushkil ke saath aasani hai. Beshak mushkil ke saath aasani hai.
explanation: Said twice for emphasis, these verses remind the reader that difficulty is not the whole story.
arabic_parts: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: In the remembrance of Allah hearts find rest
arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
transliteration: Ala bidhikrillahi tatma'innul-qulub.
english_translation: Surely, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
roman_urdu_translation: Khabardar! Allah ke zikr se hi dilon ko itminan milta hai.
explanation: Describes the calm that comes to a believing heart through remembering Allah. It is not a promise that every worry will vanish.
arabic_parts: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah
arabic: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Qul ya 'ibadiyal-ladhina asrafu 'ala anfusihim la taqnatu min rahmatillah, innallaha yaghfirudh-dhunuba jami'a, innahu huwal-ghafurur-rahim.
english_translation: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
roman_urdu_translation: Keh do: Ae mere bando jinhon ne apni jaanon par ziyadti ki, Allah ki rehmat se mayoos na ho. Beshak Allah tamam gunah maaf kar deta hai. Beshak woh bohat bakhshne wala, meherbaan hai.
explanation: An open invitation to those weighed down by their sins: despair is not the believer's answer to sin.
arabic_parts: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Whoever relies upon Allah, He is sufficient for them
arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
transliteration: Wa man yatawakkal 'alallahi fahuwa hasbuh. Innallaha balighu amrih. Qad ja'alallahu likulli shay'in qadra.
english_translation: And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for them. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has set a measure for everything.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur jo Allah par bharosa karta hai to woh uske liye kaafi hai. Beshak Allah apna kaam poora kar ke rehta hai. Allah ne har cheez ka ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai.
explanation: Encourages trust in Allah. Scholars explain that reliance includes taking sensible means while leaving the outcome with Him.
arabic_parts: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity
arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ
transliteration: La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat.
english_translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It will have what it has earned, and it will bear what it has earned.
roman_urdu_translation: Allah kisi jaan par uski taqat se ziyada bojh nahin daalta. Jo usne kamaya woh usi ka hai aur jo usne kiya uska bojh usi par hai.
explanation: A reassurance that what Allah asks of a person is within what the person can bear.
arabic_parts: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Seek help through patience and prayer
arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
transliteration: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanus-ta'inu bis-sabri was-salah, innallaha ma'as-sabirin.
english_translation: O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae iman walo! Sabr aur namaz se madad talab karo. Beshak Allah sabr karne walon ke saath hai.
explanation: Names two practical sources of strength during difficulty: patience and prayer.
arabic_parts: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Do not weaken and do not grieve
arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa la tahinu wa la tahzanu wa antumul-a'lawna in kuntum mu'minin.
english_translation: Do not weaken and do not grieve, for you will be superior if you are believers.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur na himmat haro aur na gham karo, tum hi sarbuland rahoge agar tum momin ho.
explanation: Addressed to the believers after a painful setback, encouraging them not to be crushed by it.
context: Revealed in Surah Al 'Imran after the Battle of Uhud.
arabic_parts: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us
arabic: لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَا
transliteration: La tahzan innallaha ma'ana.
english_translation: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.
roman_urdu_translation: Gham na kar, beshak Allah hamare saath hai.
explanation: The words the Prophet ﷺ said to his companion in the cave during their migration, when they were in danger.
context: Spoken by the Prophet ﷺ to Abu Bakr in the cave of Thawr.
arabic_parts: لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَا
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Do not despair of Allah's relief
arabic: وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa la tay'asu min rawhillah, innahu la yay'asu min rawhillahi illal-qawmul-kafirun.
english_translation: Do not despair of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur Allah ki rehmat se mayoos na ho. Beshak Allah ki rehmat se woh log hi mayoos hote hain jo kafir hain.
explanation: Said by Prophet Ya'qub (peace be upon him) to his sons while he still grieved for Yusuf and hoped for his return.
context: Ya'qub (peace be upon him) said this to his sons.
arabic_parts: وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: I only complain of my sorrow and grief to Allah
arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Innama ashku baththi wa huzni ilallahi wa a'lamu minallahi ma la ta'lamun.
english_translation: He said: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know.
roman_urdu_translation: Unhon ne kaha: Main apni pareshani aur gham ki shikayat sirf Allah se karta hoon, aur Allah ki taraf se woh jaanta hoon jo tum nahin jaante.
explanation: A model for bringing sorrow openly to Allah, rather than hiding it.
context: The words of Prophet Ya'qub (peace be upon him) grieving for his son Yusuf.
arabic_parts: إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Those who restrain anger and pardon people
arabic: وَٱلْكَٰظِمِينَ ٱلْغَيْظَ وَٱلْعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
transliteration: Wal-kaziminal-ghayza wal-'afina 'anin-nas, wallahu yuhibbul-muhsinin.
english_translation: ...those who restrain anger and pardon people. And Allah loves the doers of good.
roman_urdu_translation: ...aur gussa pi jane wale aur logon ko maaf kar dene wale, aur Allah neki karne walon se mohabbat karta hai.
explanation: Part of a description of the righteous: they hold back anger and pardon others.
context: From Surah Al 'Imran, in a verse describing the people of taqwa.
arabic_parts: وَٱلْكَٰظِمِينَ ٱلْغَيْظَ وَٱلْعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Indeed I am near
arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
transliteration: Wa idha sa'alaka 'ibadi 'anni fa inni qarib, ujibu da'watad-da'i idha da'an, falyastajibu li walyu'minu bi la'allahum yarshudun.
english_translation: And when My servants ask you about Me — indeed I am near. I respond to the call of the caller when he calls on Me. So let them respond to Me and believe in Me, that they may be guided.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur jab mere bande aap se mere baare mein poochhein to (keh do) main qareeb hoon. Pukarne wale ki pukar ka jawab deta hoon jab woh mujhe pukare. Pas woh meri baat maanein aur mujh par iman rakhein taake hidayat pa jayen.
explanation: Allah describes Himself as near to those who call on Him. Scholars note that a response can take different forms and come in His timing.
arabic_parts: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: We are closer to a person than the jugular vein
arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
transliteration: Wa nahnu aqrabu ilayhi min hablil-warid.
english_translation: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur hum us ki shah rag se bhi ziyada us ke qareeb hain.
explanation: Speaks of Allah's complete knowledge of the human being, who is never beyond His awareness.
arabic_parts: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Do not fear; I am with you, hearing and seeing
arabic: لَا تَخَافَآ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
transliteration: La takhafa innani ma'akuma asma'u wa ara.
english_translation: Do not fear. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
roman_urdu_translation: Dar mat, main tum dono ke saath hoon, sunta aur dekhta hoon.
explanation: Allah's reassurance to Musa and Harun (peace be upon them) before facing Pharaoh.
context: Allah addressed Musa and Harun (peace be upon them) as they were sent to Pharaoh.
arabic_parts: لَا تَخَافَآ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Perhaps you dislike something and it is good for you
arabic: وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكْرَهُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Wa 'asa an takrahu shay'an wa huwa khayrun lakum, wa 'asa an tuhibbu shay'an wa huwa sharrun lakum, wallahu ya'lamu wa antum la ta'lamun.
english_translation: Perhaps you dislike something while it is good for you, and perhaps you love something while it is bad for you. Allah knows, and you do not know.
roman_urdu_translation: Ho sakta hai tum kisi cheez ko na pasand karo aur woh tumhare liye behtar ho, aur ho sakta hai tum kisi cheez ko pasand karo aur woh tumhare liye buri ho. Allah jaanta hai aur tum nahin jaante.
explanation: A reminder that human judgment about what is good for us is limited.
context: From the verse about fighting being prescribed, addressing a case where the believers disliked something.
arabic_parts: وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكْرَهُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: When you have decided, rely upon Allah
arabic: فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
transliteration: Fa idha 'azamta fa tawakkal 'alallah, innallaha yuhibbul-mutawakkilin.
english_translation: Then when you have made a decision, rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely upon Him.
roman_urdu_translation: Phir jab tum faisla kar lo to Allah par bharosa karo. Beshak Allah bharosa karne walon se mohabbat karta hai.
explanation: Follows an instruction to consult others: seek advice, decide, then trust Allah with the outcome.
arabic_parts: فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Indeed we belong to Allah, and to Him we will return
arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
transliteration: Alladhina idha asabat-hum musibatun qalu inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un.
english_translation: Those who, when a calamity strikes them, say: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.
roman_urdu_translation: Woh log ke jab unhein koi museebat pahunchti hai to kehte hain: Hum Allah ke hain aur hamein usi ki taraf lautna hai.
explanation: The words the Quran describes for those who are patient when calamity strikes.
arabic_parts: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: If you are grateful, I will give you more
arabic: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌ
transliteration: La'in shakartum la azidannakum, wa la'in kafartum inna 'adhabi lashadid.
english_translation: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you; but if you are ungrateful, indeed My punishment is severe.
roman_urdu_translation: Agar tum shukr karoge to main tumhein aur ziyada dunga, aur agar nashukri karoge to beshak mera azaab bohat sakht hai.
explanation: Allah's own statement about gratitude. Scholars discuss in what ways the 'increase' may come, and it is not limited to wealth.
arabic_parts: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Remember Me, and I will remember you
arabic: فَٱذْكُرُونِىٓ أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لِى وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
transliteration: Fadhkuruni adhkurkum washkuru li wa la takfurun.
english_translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me, and do not be ungrateful to Me.
roman_urdu_translation: Pas tum mujhe yaad karo, main tumhein yaad karunga. Aur meri shukrguzari karo aur meri nashukri na karo.
explanation: An invitation to remember Allah, joined with a call to gratitude.
arabic_parts: فَٱذْكُرُونِىٓ أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لِى وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Allah loves those who repent
arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلتَّوَّٰبِينَ وَيُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
transliteration: Innallaha yuhibbut-tawwabina wa yuhibbul-mutatahhirin.
english_translation: Indeed, Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves.
roman_urdu_translation: Beshak Allah tauba karne walon se mohabbat karta hai aur paak rehne walon se mohabbat karta hai.
explanation: Presents repentance as something Allah loves, rather than something to be ashamed of.
arabic_parts: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلتَّوَّٰبِينَ وَيُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: I am Forgiving to whoever repents, believes and does good
arabic: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
transliteration: Wa inni laghaffarun liman taba wa amana wa 'amila salihan thumma ihtada.
english_translation: And indeed, I am the Most Forgiving to whoever repents, believes, does righteous deeds, and then remains guided.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur beshak main bohat bakhshne wala hoon uske liye jo tauba kare, iman laye, nek amal kare aur phir hidayat par qaim rahe.
explanation: States the pattern of repentance Allah describes: turn back, believe, act well, and stay on the path.
arabic_parts: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Allah is sufficient for me
arabic: حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huw, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'azim.
english_translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I have placed my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
roman_urdu_translation: Mujhe Allah kaafi hai. Uske siwa koi mabood nahin. Maine usi par bharosa kiya aur woh azeem arsh ka Rab hai.
explanation: The Quran instructs the Prophet ﷺ to say this if people turn away. It is also used as a statement of reliance.
context: The final verse of Surat at-Tawbah.
arabic_parts: حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Surat al-Ikhlas
arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
english_translation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him.
roman_urdu_translation: Keh do: Woh Allah ek hai. Allah be-niyaz hai. Na uski koi aulaad hai aur na woh kisi ki aulaad hai. Aur koi uska hamsar nahin.
explanation: A short statement of Allah's oneness. The Prophet ﷺ recited it with the next two surahs before sleeping.
repetition_note: Narrated for bedtime: recited, then blown into the palms and wiped over the body, three times (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).
arabic_parts: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Surat al-Falaq
arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
english_translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of the darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
roman_urdu_translation: Keh do: Main subah ke Rab ki panah mangta hoon, har us cheez ke shar se jo usne paida ki, andheri raat ke shar se jab woh chha jaye, girahon mein phoonkne walon ke shar se, aur hasad karne wale ke shar se jab woh hasad kare.
explanation: Seeks refuge in Allah from evil in its different forms.
repetition_note: Narrated for bedtime: recited, then blown into the palms and wiped over the body, three times (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).
arabic_parts: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Surat an-Nas
arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduri-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
english_translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whispering withdrawer, who whispers in the hearts of mankind — from among jinn and mankind.
roman_urdu_translation: Keh do: Main logon ke Rab ki panah mangta hoon, logon ke badshah ki, logon ke mabood ki, pichhe hat jane wale waswase daalne wale ke shar se, jo logon ke seenon mein waswase daalta hai, jinnon mein se ho ya insanon mein se.
explanation: Seeks refuge in Allah from the whispering that unsettles the heart.
repetition_note: Narrated for bedtime: recited, then blown into the palms and wiped over the body, three times (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).
arabic_parts: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
audio_source: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via the Islamic Network audio CDN (cdn.islamic.network)

title: Ayat al-Kursi
arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'aliyyul-'azim.
english_translation: Allah — there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Almighty.
roman_urdu_translation: Allah, uske siwa koi mabood nahin, woh zinda hai, sab ko thamne wala hai. Use na unghh aati hai na neend. Usi ka hai jo aasmanon mein hai aur jo zameen mein hai. Kaun hai jo uske huzoor uski ijazat ke baghair sifarish kare? Woh jaanta hai jo unke saamne hai aur jo unke peechhe hai, aur woh uske ilm mein se kisi cheez ka ehata nahin kar sakte magar jitna woh chahe. Uski kursi aasmanon aur zameen par chhai hui hai aur in dono ki hifazat use thakati nahin, aur woh bohat buland, bohat azeem hai.
explanation: The most renowned verse of the Quran, describing Allah's life, sovereignty and knowledge.
context: In the narration of Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him), a guard from Allah stays with the one who recites it at night (Sahih al-Bukhari 2311).
arabic_parts: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

title: The last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah
arabic: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal-mu'minun, kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, la nufarriqu bayna ahadin mir-rusulih, wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na ghufranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-masir. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat. Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na. Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
english_translation: The Messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. All of them believe in Allah, His angels, His Books and His messengers: 'We make no distinction between any of His messengers.' And they say: 'We hear and we obey. Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final return.' Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It will have what it has earned, and it will bear what it has earned. Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place on us a burden like the one You placed on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.
roman_urdu_translation: Rasool us par iman laye jo unke Rab ki taraf se un par utara gaya, aur momin bhi. Sab Allah par, uske farishton par, uski kitabon par aur uske rasoolon par iman laye. Hum uske rasoolon mein se kisi mein farq nahin karte. Aur unhon ne kaha: Humne suna aur maana. Ae hamare Rab! Teri bakhshish chahiye aur teri hi taraf lautna hai. Allah kisi jaan par uski taqat se ziyada bojh nahin daalta. Jo usne kamaya woh usi ka hai aur jo kiya uska bojh usi par hai. Ae hamare Rab! Agar hum bhool jayen ya ghalti karein to hamein na pakad. Ae hamare Rab! Hum par woh bojh na daal jo tu ne hum se pehle logon par dala. Ae hamare Rab! Hum se woh na uthwa jis ki hamein taqat nahin. Hamein maaf kar de, bakhsh de aur hum par raham farma. Tu hi hamara maula hai, to kafir qaum ke muqable mein hamari madad farma.
explanation: The closing verses of Surat al-Baqarah. The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever recites them at night, they will suffice him; scholars explain this in several ways.
context: Recited at night, as narrated in Sahih al-Bukhari 5009 and Sahih Muslim 807.
arabic_parts: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

title: Sayyid al-Istighfar — the master supplication for forgiveness
narrator: Shaddad ibn Aws (may Allah be pleased with him)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't. A'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't. Abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
english_translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I hold to Your covenant and Your promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for no one forgives sins but You.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae Allah! Tu mera Rab hai, tere siwa koi mabood nahin. Tu ne mujhe paida kiya aur main tera banda hoon, aur main apni taqat bhar tere ahd aur wade par qaim hoon. Jo kuchh maine kiya uske shar se teri panah mangta hoon. Main apne upar teri naimat ka iqrar karta hoon aur apne gunah ka iqrar karta hoon, pas mujhe bakhsh de, kyunke tere siwa koi gunah nahin bakhshta.
explanation: Acknowledges Allah's lordship and favour, admits one's own sin, and asks for forgiveness. The Prophet ﷺ named it the master of istighfar.
context: The narration describes it as a supplication for the morning and evening. The same hadith also states a reward for those who say it with firm belief; please read the full narration for that wording.
arabic_parts: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ

title: Refuge from worry, grief, weakness and heavy debt
narrator: Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
english_translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from being overwhelmed by debt and from being overpowered by men.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae Allah! Main teri panah mangta hoon fikr aur gham se, bebasi aur susti se, bukhl aur buzdili se, qarz ke bojh se aur logon ke ghalbe se.
explanation: Names several burdens that weigh on a person — worry, grief, weakness, debt — and asks Allah for refuge from them.
context: Anas reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to make this supplication often.
arabic_parts: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ

title: The supplication in times of distress
narrator: 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (may Allah be pleased with him)
arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'azimul-halim. La ilaha illallahu rabbul-'arshil-'azim. La ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul-ardi wa rabbul-'arshil-karim.
english_translation: There is no god but Allah, the Almighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
roman_urdu_translation: Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin, woh azeem aur burdbar hai. Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin, woh azeem arsh ka Rab hai. Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin, woh aasmanon ka Rab, zameen ka Rab aur izzat wale arsh ka Rab hai.
explanation: Responds to distress by reminding oneself of Allah's greatness, patience and lordship over everything.
context: Ibn 'Abbas reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to say this at times of distress.
arabic_parts: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ

title: Guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency
narrator: 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-'afafa wal-ghina.
english_translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae Allah! Main tujh se hidayat, taqwa, paakdamni aur be-niyazi (ghina) ka sawal karta hoon.
explanation: A compact request for four things: right guidance, God-consciousness, moral restraint, and contentment that needs nothing from people.
context: Ibn Mas'ud reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to make this supplication.

title: Grant my soul its piety and purify it
narrator: Zayd ibn Arqam (may Allah be pleased with him)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلاَهَا
transliteration: Allahumma ati nafsi taqwaha, wa zakkiha anta khayru man zakkaha, anta waliyyuha wa mawlaha.
english_translation: O Allah, grant my soul its piety and purify it; You are the best of those who purify it. You are its Protector and its Master.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae Allah! Mere nafs ko uski parhezgari ata farma aur use paak kar de, tu behtareen paak karne wala hai. Tu hi uska kaarsaz aur maula hai.
explanation: Asks Allah to give the self piety and to purify it, since He alone truly can.
context: Zayd ibn Arqam reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to say this supplication.

title: Refuge from knowledge that does not benefit and a heart that has no awe of Allah
narrator: Zayd ibn Arqam (may Allah be pleased with him)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لاَ يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لاَ يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لاَ تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لاَ يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa', wa min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha.
english_translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not stand in awe (khushu') of You, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae Allah! Main teri panah mangta hoon us ilm se jo nafa na de, us dil se jo (tere khauf se) na dare aur na jhuke, us nafs se jo kabhi na bhare aur us dua se jo qabool na ho.
explanation: Asks that knowledge, the heart, desire and supplication all be good and beneficial.
context: Zayd ibn Arqam reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to say this supplication.
arabic_parts: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لاَ يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لاَ يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لاَ تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لاَ يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا

title: Turn our hearts to Your obedience
narrator: 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr ibn al-'As (may Allah be pleased with him)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma musarrifal-qulubi sarrif qulubana 'ala ta'atik.
english_translation: O Allah, Turner of hearts, turn our hearts to Your obedience.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae Allah! Dilon ke phernay wale, hamare dilon ko apni farmanbardari ki taraf phair de.
explanation: Asks Allah, who controls the hearts, to direct them toward obedience.
context: The Prophet ﷺ said that the hearts of all people are between two fingers of the Most Merciful, and He turns them as He wills; then he made this supplication.
arabic_parts: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ

title: Istikhara — asking Allah to choose what is good
narrator: Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'azim, fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri — aw qala: 'ajili amri wa ajilih — faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fih. Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri — aw qala: fi 'ajili amri wa ajilih — fasrifhu 'anni wasrifni 'anhu, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kana thumma ardini bih.
english_translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge, and I seek Your ability through Your power, and I ask You from Your immense bounty. You are able and I am not; You know and I do not; and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs — or he said: in my present and future — then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless it for me. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs — or he said: in my present and future — then turn it away from me, turn me away from it, decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me content with it.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae Allah! Main tere ilm ke zariye tujh se khair talab karta hoon, teri qudrat ke zariye taqat mangta hoon aur tere azeem fazl ka sawal karta hoon. Tu qadir hai aur main qadir nahin, tu jaanta hai aur main nahin jaanta, aur tu ghaib ki baatein khoob jaanne wala hai. Ae Allah! Agar tu jaanta hai ke yeh kaam mere deen, meri zindagi aur mere anjaam ke liye behtar hai — ya (raavi ne kaha) mere jald aur der ke kaam ke liye — to use mere liye muqaddar kar de, aasan kar de aur phir mujhe usme barkat de. Aur agar tu jaanta hai ke yeh kaam mere deen, meri zindagi aur mere anjaam ke liye bura hai — ya (raavi ne kaha) mere jald aur der ke kaam ke liye — to use mujh se phair de aur mujhe us se phair de, aur jahan bhi bhalai ho mere liye muqaddar kar de, phir mujhe us par razi kar de.
explanation: Taught for situations of decision-making: the person asks Allah to bring about what is good and remove what is not, and to be content with the result.
context: Jabir reported that the Prophet ﷺ taught the istikhara in all matters, as he taught a surah of the Quran: pray two voluntary rak'ahs, then say this supplication, and mention the matter at the place of 'this matter'.
arabic_parts: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
grading_source: Reported in Sahih al-Bukhari and/or Sahih Muslim, the two collections whose compilers set authenticity as a condition of inclusion.

title: I have greatly wronged myself — forgive me
narrator: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathira, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indik, warhamni innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim.
english_translation: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and no one forgives sins but You. So grant me forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me. You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae Allah! Maine apni jaan par bohat zulm kiya aur tere siwa koi gunah maaf nahin karta. Pas apni taraf se mujhe bakhsh de aur mujh par raham farma. Beshak tu hi bohat bakhshne wala, meherbaan hai.
explanation: A direct plea for forgiveness and mercy that the Prophet ﷺ taught Abu Bakr for his prayer.
context: Abu Bakr asked the Prophet ﷺ to teach him a supplication to make in his prayer, and he taught him this.
arabic_parts: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
grading_source: Reported in Sahih al-Bukhari and/or Sahih Muslim, the two collections whose compilers set authenticity as a condition of inclusion.
